name: t13-read-v7
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 27 Oct night; ideas from Matteo's observed-growth-v10 (branch matteo/main): best value at the level, two-month review window, repair at once
hypothesis: In the replica, with a DeepSeek-like quarter that does not know the ceilings, a Skill-first quarter from L4 (Skill learning and rotation) scores 51.1 against 52.0 without it, because Output falls behind and Skill learning's Health cost ends more runs. A balanced L4 quarter (Health first when not high, then Skill learning plus Prepare report materials, main action Apply for a key project) scores 52.8 and doubles L6 (11 % against 6 %).
predicted_behaviour: From L4, Skill and Output both grow; more L5 promotions than v6; no rise in Health failures.
refutation: Fewer L5 promotions or more Health failures than v6 in official games.
